sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: The upsides first: very practical staple food. Cheap, common, and easy to build meals around, which matters for a tuber category built on energy foods. Can be fairly filling. Especially when eaten in less processed forms. Brings some useful potassium. Not amazing, but enough to matter a bit in the category.
